reference.product: Native Instruments Traktor DJ for iPad 1.x

fidelity_rules: Preserve original sound, timing, gestures, UI feedback, defaults, state, persistence and quirks.

Apply the confirmed lexicographic suggestion policy: key, BPM within ±8%, similar energy, then previous undirected pairing. Retain historical genre/timbre reports as reference evidence; do not insert independent weights into the confirmed ordering.
Retain ordinary functions in full replication scope.
Keep documented capabilities, performer reports, local evidence and unresolved details distinct.
Match target-build behaviour. Keep historical version and controller boundaries explicit.
Resolve unknowns against the reference rather than substitute plausible policies.
Existing proposed engine models are non-normative hypotheses.
Internal implementation may differ only where original observable behaviour remains equivalent.
Do not add controls, gestures, providers, explanations or workflow changes without a separate user request.
All original iPad gestures require 1:1 support and paired multitouch acceptance, including selection, gridding, zoom, XY filter controls and simultaneous gestures.

completion_rule: Every confirmed original behaviour must match agreed reference cases. Investigate candidate features and record presence or absence. Unknown policies, missing outputs and unmatched sound or interactions prevent a claim of complete fidelity.

current_performer_requirements.precedence: Direct performer clarifications supersede conflicting historical reports or unknown-policy placeholders below.
current_performer_requirements.audio_output_priority: Combined audio output and responsive performance controls always take priority over analysis, search, artwork, import and recording work.
current_performer_requirements.minimum_hardware: 10.5-inch iPad Pro (2017, A10X, 4 GB), directly confirmed 28 October 2026.
current_performer_requirements.early_synced_play: Prefer the next four-beat bar; after beat 2, wait for the next bar. End-of-reference next-beat fallback remains a development interpretation.
current_performer_requirements.queued_second_play: Cancels pending incoming start, directly confirmed in coordinated chat.
